title: Exploring The Embercore Path
description: Exploring The Embercore Path — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Explore the many branches connected to Upper Embercore Path and return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Loremaster Vraile

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Exploring The Embercore Path

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Explore the many branches connected to Upper Embercore Path and return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Offer:

The Townston Commander said what? Well, I imagine he is just upset that I haven't asked him to finger-paint anything recently. Well, it isn't my fault the man has fingers like a sausage and his maps look like a napkin after he has eaten barbequed ribs! Now your fingers, on the other hand, are nice and delicate, almost dainty, as if they haven't worked a day in their life.

Back to why I asked for you. The Embercore Path is very interesting dungeon and one that has become a firestorm of activity. You see, The Embercore Path used to be a wonderful candy factory run by a man named Wally Wanka. Every year he would announce new amazing candy flavors that had the men, women, and children PVPing for a taste. Wanka's candies became so popular that he had to shut down his factory to the public because they kept farming for phat treats. It wasn't long after Wanka closed the factory to the public that something terrible happened: monsters took over the candy factory! No one is sure exactly when it happened, but the word is that a dungeon overlord named Abaddon is now the boss of The Embercore Path.

I would like you to get into The Embercore Path and find out what all has changed so I can make the necessary changes to my records. Return to me, Loremaster Vraile, here in Townston when you have explored more of The Embercore Path.

Turn-in:

What do you know, Dungeon Runner? Has Abaddon gained full control of the dungeon?

Objectives:

  • Storeroom 1A: Thumb Knuckles, Hairy Wrists, and Bulbous Elbows
  • Storeroom 3A: Cankles, Webbed Toes, and Knobby Knees
  • Storeroom 4A: Loins, Keisters, and Pot Bellys

Level range: 40–100
